reviews.title: Quality, affordable laptop stand
reviews.body: It is a great stand.  It lifts my laptop to my desired height for maximum visibility and comfort while saving room on my desk for a keyboard and mouse.  The rotation ability is very useful.  I have used it at different heights and is very sturdy at all heights.  You do have to adjust the angle of the laptop the higher you use the stand to ensure it is sturdy.  There is tension in adjusting the stand.  I am fine with it as I believe that tension keeps it locked into the height you select. It completely folds flat for ease of portability. I would recommend this stand as it is well made at a good price.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on February 21, 2026
reviews.author: Kathy Carmody

reviews.title: Great, Sturdy, Lightweight, Handles 17” laptop with ease!
reviews.body: I’m in RN school. This is light, but a beast. Great quality, durability, and keeps my 17” HP wherever I want it in height or extension with zero stability issues! I used it initially to give the fan more airflow during long exams.  Now I always use it at home for different eye levels during use. Great product!
